brief.summary_1line: Rama admires the mountain’s beauty and tells Sita that its peace eases his pain of exile and separation from Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands beside Sita on a high mountain ridge, pointing toward multicolored peaks glittering with gems and metals under the sky.
Waterfalls cascade down a lush mountain while birds circle above and lions and leopards rest peacefully near hermit dwellings.
Kinnera couples wander among flowering trees with their swords and bright garments hanging from branches in a fragrant mountain breeze.
